candidates.notes: Open access, fully accessible. Addresses 3D TBR calculation methodology for stellarators using OpenMC. The realistic TBR value of ~1.15 cited in the analysis for HELIAS with 20mm gaps originates from this paper. No open-access alternative found for the specific HELIAS 5-B TBR-with-gaps calculation. The ParaStell paper provides methodological context (importance of 3D modeling) but not HELIAS-specific values. G-7 remains open; future attempts should target EuroFusion publication portal (requires institutional access) or author preprints.

summary.notes: G-2 partially addressed: ARIES-CS 85% availability (core-outputs-100308302) adds a second analog anchor alongside Helios 88% (from iter-2). G-7 not closed: Bongiovi 2022 (the primary source for HELIAS realistic TBR with gaps) is paywalled with no accessible preprint found; ParaStell paper extracted as methodology background only.
